svg.aria-label: Golem, wake up! On parchment under a crescent moon, the golem sleeps with its head bowed and eyes shut, and the shem, a small scroll, slides into the slot in its forehead. On a dark screen the shem glows in the same golem's forehead, its eyes light up green, and a prompt types: dollar golem tui, then hello.
